title: The board: from your desk into the world
reflection: Your button opened a door in the game, and a lever in the game lit up your board. Where in real life does a button, a sensor or a light talk to a computer far away?

steps.goal: MINE has put an iron door in front of your Byte. When you press A on your board (it writes pulsante_a:1), the door must open, and close by itself 3 seconds later. Connect the board with /mine device to try it; MINE presses A on your board to test it.
steps.not_yet: Not yet: when the board writes pulsante_a:1, the door must open, and close again 3 seconds later.
hints: mine.device.wait("pulsante_a") stops Byte until the board writes pulsante_a. Then open the door with redstone.setOutput("front", true).
Inside while true do ... end: mine.device.wait("pulsante_a"), redstone.setOutput("front", true), os.sleep(3), redstone.setOutput("front", false).
block_hints: In the Board category, "wait for pulsante_a from the board" stops Byte until you press A. Then "redstone signal in front set to true".
Inside "repeat while true": "wait for pulsante_a from the board", "redstone signal in front set to true", "wait 3 seconds", "redstone signal in front set to false".

steps.goal: Now a lamp behind your Byte. The board measures the light in your classroom and writes it (luce:0 is dark, luce:255 very bright). Make a night light: the lamp is on only when the light is below 50. Cover the board with your hand to try it; MINE plays the light to test it.
steps.not_yet: Not yet: the lamp must be on when luce is below 50, and off when it's 50 or more.
hints: mine.device.read("luce") is the last light the board wrote. A comparison, mine.device.read("luce") < 50, is true when it's dark.
Inside while true do ... end: redstone.setOutput("back", mine.device.read("luce") < 50), then os.sleep(0.5) so Byte doesn't check without stopping.
block_hints: "board value luce" is the last light the board wrote. Put it in a comparison from Logic: "board value luce < 50" is true when it's dark.
Inside "repeat while true": "redstone signal behind set to" with "board value luce < 50" in it, then "wait 0.5 seconds".

steps.goal: Last one, the other way: a lever on the ground at your Byte's left. When the lever is on, the heart on your board lights up: Byte writes cuore:1 on the board, and cuore:0 when the lever goes back. MINE pulls the lever to test it.
steps.not_yet: Not yet: with the lever on Byte must write cuore:1 on the board, and cuore:0 when it's off.
hints: The lever is next to Byte: redstone.getInput("left") is true while it's on. os.pullEvent("redstone") waits until it changes.
Inside while true do ... end: os.pullEvent("redstone"), then if redstone.getInput("left") then mine.device.send("cuore", 1) else mine.device.send("cuore", 0) end.
block_hints: "signal from left?" is true while the lever is on. "send to the board cuore 1" is in the Board category.
Inside "repeat while true": "wait for a redstone change", then "if signal from left?": "send to the board cuore 1", else "send to the board cuore 0".
